quest:Lord_of_the_Hunt4.name: Small_Stingers,_Big_Owie
quest:Lord_of_the_Hunt4.description: Go trap Scorpie Critters. No hint where they are, sorry... I'm still stuck on the Crabbo quest myself!

quest:Lord_of_the_Hunt11.name: To_Trap_or_not_to_Trap
quest:Lord_of_the_Hunt11.description: Catch a TON of Shinies... like, a TOOOOOON.

quest:Blobbo2.name: Glitter_Critter
quest:Blobbo2.description: Ah I see, she actually said her children love shiny things, and chased after some shiny critters. Bring as many shiny critters as you can, I'm sure they'll come flopping back!

item:ExpBalloon3.name: Large_Experience_Balloon
item:ExpBalloon3.description: Hold down to gain EXP in the skill that's displayed in the corner of your screen. If you're in a town, you will gain EXP in the town skill. The amount of EXP you get is based on your skill's Lv.

item:Timecandy3.name: 4_HR_Time_Candy
item:Timecandy3.description: Hold down to instantly get 4 Hour of AFK Gains.

item:Critter3.name: Scorpie
item:Critter3.description: This cutie will stab its way into your heart if you aren't careful! No seriosuly, be careful, the bugger pricked my foot the other day and it hurt bad.

item:Critter6A.name: Eternal_Lord_of_The_Undying_Ember
item:Critter6A.description: Bow before the destroyer of all that lies outside his domain, the ruler of the 8th dimension and all that it's flame encompasses, the bringer of light to the blind, and darkness to those who recite his title in full. ...ah crap.

item:Critter9A.name: Diamond_Duck
item:Critter9A.description: One of the only beings strong enough to take on the Eternal Lord of the Undying Ember realm. Their battle would be legendary.

item:Ladle.name: Cooking_Ladle
item:Ladle.description: Hold down to boost all your kitchens ahead by 1 hour for each ladle in this stack. The entire stack will be used up when you do.

item:PetEgg.name: Mob_Egg
item:PetEgg.description: Hold down to instantly incubate eggs for your nest in World 4. It'll only use up eggs that you have space to carry, dont worry about wasting these!

item:Critter8A.name: Jade_Scarab
item:Critter8A.description: Oh I guess this one is a scarab, not a beetle. You can tell because of the way it is.
